stem: In 2000, table tennis adopted a new official ball. What diameter is that ball?
explanation: The old ball measured 38 mm. The switch came after the Sydney Olympics: a bigger ball meets more air resistance, so rallies run a little slower and are easier to follow on television.

claims.text: The table tennis ball adopted for official play in 2000 has a diameter of 40 mm.
The ball adopted in 2000 is not 32 mm, 35 mm or 38 mm across.
Before the change, the official table tennis ball measured 38 mm across.
The International Table Tennis Federation brought in the 40 mm ball in October 2000, after the Sydney Olympic Games.
The larger ball was adopted to slow the game slightly and make rallies easier for spectators and television viewers to follow.
